versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה פְּסָל־לְךָ֛ שְׁנֵֽי־לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וְכָתַבְתִּי֙ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Chisel two stone tablets like the first: and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which thou brakest.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Entalha para ti duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras, e escreverei sobre essas tábuas as palavras que estavam nas tábuas primeiras que quebraste.

versos.hebraico: וֶהְיֵ֥ה נָכ֖וֹן לַבֹּ֑קֶר וְעָלִ֤יתָ בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וְנִצַּבְתָּ֥ לִ֛י שָׁ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָֽר׃

controles.web: Be ready by the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai, and present yourself there to me on the top of the mountain.
controles.kjv: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
controles.livre: Prepara-te, pois, para amanhã, e sobe pela manhã ao monte de Sinai, e fica diante de mim ali sobre o cume do monte.

versos.hebraico: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֣ה עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־אִ֥ישׁ אַל־יֵרָ֖א בְּכָל־הָהָ֑ר גַּם־הַצֹּ֤אן וְהַבָּקָר֙ אַל־יִרְע֔וּ אֶל־מ֖וּל הָהָ֥ר הַהֽוּא׃

controles.web: No one shall come up with you; neither let anyone be seen throughout all the mountain; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mountain.”
controles.kjv: And no man shall come up with thee, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
controles.livre: E não suba homem contigo, nem apareça alguém em todo o monte; nem ovelhas nem bois apascentem diante do monte.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְסֹ֡ל שְׁנֵֽי־לֻחֹ֨ת אֲבָנִ֜ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֗ים וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם מֹשֶׁ֤ה בַבֹּ֨קֶר֙ וַיַּ֨עַל֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַיִּקַּ֣ח בְּיָד֔וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִֽים׃

controles.web: He chiseled two tablets of stone like the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up to Mount Sinai, as Yahweh had commanded him, and took in his hand two stone tablets.
controles.kjv: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
controles.livre: E Moisés entalhou duas tábuas de pedra como as primeiras; e levantou-se pela manhã, e subiu ao monte de Sinai, como lhe mandou o SENHOR, e levou em sua mão as duas tábuas de pedra.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן וַיִּתְיַצֵּ֥ב עִמּ֖וֹ שָׁ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֥א בְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed Yahweh’s name.
controles.kjv: And the Lord descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of the Lord.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR desceu na nuvem, e esteve ali com ele, proclamando o nome do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּעֲבֹ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה׀ עַל־פָּנָיו֮ וַיִּקְרָא֒ יְהוָ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֥ל רַח֖וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֶ֥רֶךְ אַפַּ֖יִם וְרַב־חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׀

controles.web: Yahweh passed by before him, and proclaimed, “Yahweh! Yahweh, a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth,
controles.kjv: And the Lord passed by before him, and proclaimed, The Lord, The Lord God, merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
controles.livre: E passando o SENHOR por diante dele, proclamou: SENHOR, SENHOR, forte, misericordioso, e piedoso; tardio para a ira, e grande em benignidade e verdade;

versos.hebraico: נֹצֵ֥ר חֶ֨סֶד֙ לָאֲלָפִ֔ים נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֛ן וָפֶ֖שַׁע וְחַטָּאָ֑ה וְנַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֣ד׀ עֲוֺ֣ן אָב֗וֹת עַל־בָּנִים֙ וְעַל־בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים עַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִֽים׃

controles.web: keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, and on the children’s children, on the third and on the fourth generation.”
controles.kjv: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
controles.livre: Que guarda a misericórdia em milhares, que perdoa a iniquidade, a rebelião, e o pecado, e que de nenhum modo justificará ao malvado; que visita a iniquidade dos pais sobre os filhos e sobre os filhos dos filhos, sobre os de terceira, e quarta gerações.

versos.hebraico: וַיְמַהֵ֖ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיִּקֹּ֥ד אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃

controles.web: Moses hurried and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
controles.kjv: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
controles.livre: Então Moisés, apressando-se, baixou a cabeça até o chão e encurvou-se;

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֡אמֶר אִם־נָא֩ מָצָ֨אתִי חֵ֤ן בְּעֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י יֵֽלֶךְ־נָ֥א אֲדֹנָ֖י בְּקִרְבֵּ֑נוּ כִּ֤י עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֨רֶף֙ ה֔וּא וְסָלַחְתָּ֛ לַעֲוֺנֵ֥נוּ וּלְחַטָּאתֵ֖נוּ וּנְחַלְתָּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, Lord, please let the Lord go in the midst of us; although this is a stiff-necked people; pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.”
controles.kjv: And he said, If now I have found grace in thy sight, O Lord, let my Lord, I pray thee, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for thine inheritance.
controles.livre: E disse: Se agora, Senhor, achei favor em teus olhos, vá agora o Senhor em meio de nós; porque este é povo de dura cerviz; e perdoa nossa iniquidade e nosso pecado, e possui-nos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִי֮ כֹּרֵ֣ת בְּרִית֒ נֶ֤גֶד כָּֽל־עַמְּךָ֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה נִפְלָאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־נִבְרְא֥וּ בְכָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבְכָל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָאָ֣ה כָל־הָ֠עָם אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֨ה בְקִרְבּ֜וֹ אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כִּֽי־נוֹרָ֣א ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֥ה עִמָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: He said, “Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been worked in all the earth, nor in any nation; and all the people among which you are shall see the work of Yahweh; for it is an awesome thing that I do with you.
controles.kjv: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all thy people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which thou art shall see the work of the Lord: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with thee.
controles.livre: E ele disse: Eis que, eu faço concerto diante de todo o teu povo: farei maravilhas que não foram feitas em toda a terra, nem em nação alguma; e verá todo o povo em meio do qual estás tu, a obra do SENHOR; porque será coisa terrível a que eu farei contigo.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמָ֨ר־לְךָ֔ אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוְּךָ֣ הַיּ֑וֹם הִנְנִ֧י גֹרֵ֣שׁ מִפָּנֶ֗יךָ אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י וְהַחִתִּי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

controles.web: Observe that which I command you this day. Behold, I drive out before you the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
controles.kjv: Observe thou that which I command thee this day: behold, I drive out before thee the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
controles.livre: Guarda o que eu te mando hoje; eis que eu expulso de diante de tua presença aos amorreus, e aos cananeus, e aos heteus, e aos perizeus, e aos heveus, e aos jebuseus.

versos.hebraico: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ פֶּן־תִּכְרֹ֤ת בְּרִית֙ לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה בָּ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ פֶּן־יִהְיֶ֥ה לְמוֹקֵ֖שׁ בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Be careful, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land where you are going, lest it be for a snare in your midst:
controles.kjv: Take heed to thyself, lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest, lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee:
controles.livre: Guarda-te que não faças aliança com os moradores da terra de onde hás de entrar, para que não sejam por tropeço em meio de ti:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י אֶת־מִזְבְּחֹתָם֙ תִּתֹּצ֔וּן וְאֶת־מַצֵּבֹתָ֖ם תְּשַׁבֵּר֑וּן וְאֶת־אֲשֵׁרָ֖יו תִּכְרֹתֽוּן׃

controles.web: but you shall break down their altars, and dash in pieces their pillars, and you shall cut down their Asherah poles;
controles.kjv: But ye shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
controles.livre: Mas derrubareis seus altares, e quebrareis suas estátuas, e cortareis seus bosques:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֛י לֹ֥א תִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לְאֵ֣ל אַחֵ֑ר כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ קַנָּ֣א שְׁמ֔וֹ אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֖א הֽוּא׃

controles.web: for you shall worship no other god: for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
controles.kjv: For thou shalt worship no other god: for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God:
controles.livre: Porque não te hás de inclinar a deus alheio; que o SENHOR, cujo nome é zeloso, Deus zeloso é.

versos.hebraico: פֶּן־תִּכְרֹ֥ת בְּרִ֖ית לְיוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְזָנ֣וּ׀ אַחֲרֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֗ם וְזָבְחוּ֙ לֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם וְקָרָ֣א לְךָ֔ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ מִזִּבְחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Don’t make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, lest they play the prostitute after their gods, and sacrifice to their gods, and one call you and you eat of his sacrifice;
controles.kjv: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call thee, and thou eat of his sacrifice;
controles.livre: Portanto não farás aliança com os moradores daquela terra; pois senão fornicarão após seus deuses, e sacrificarão a seus deuses, e te chamarão, e comerás de seus sacrifícios;

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ מִבְּנֹתָ֖יו לְבָנֶ֑יךָ וְזָנ֣וּ בְנֹתָ֗יו אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ן וְהִזְנוּ֙ אֶת־בָּנֶ֔יךָ אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃

controles.web: and you take of their daughters to your sons, and their daughters play the prostitute after their gods, and make your sons play the prostitute after their gods.
controles.kjv: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods.
controles.livre: Ou, se tomarem de suas filhas para teus filhos, e fornicarem suas filhas após seus deuses, farão também fornicar a teus filhos atrás dos deuses delas.

versos.hebraico: אֱלֹהֵ֥י מַסֵּכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: “You shall make no cast idols for yourselves.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods.
controles.livre: Não farás deuses de fundição para ti.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־חַ֣ג הַמַּצּוֹת֮ תִּשְׁמֹר֒ שִׁבְעַ֨ת יָמִ֜ים תֹּאכַ֤ל מַצּוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ךָ לְמוֹעֵ֖ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָאָבִ֑יב כִּ֚י בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאָבִ֔יב יָצָ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: “You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib; for in the month Abib you came out of Egypt.
controles.kjv: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep. Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, as I commanded thee, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt.
controles.livre: A festa dos pães ázimos guardarás: sete dias comerás sem levedar, segundo te mandei, no tempo do mês de Abibe; porque no mês de Abibe saíste do Egito.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם לִ֑י וְכָֽל־מִקְנְךָ֙ תִּזָּכָ֔ר פֶּ֖טֶר שׁ֥וֹר וָשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: “All that opens the womb is mine; and all your livestock that is male, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
controles.kjv: All that openeth the matrix is mine; and every firstling among thy cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
controles.livre: Todo o que abre madre, meu é; e de teu gado todo primeiro de vaca ou de ovelha que for macho.

versos.hebraico: וּפֶ֤טֶר חֲמוֹר֙ תִּפְדֶּ֣ה בְשֶׂ֔ה וְאִם־לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה וַעֲרַפְתּ֑וֹ כֹּ֣ל בְּכ֤וֹר בָּנֶ֨יךָ֙ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יֵרָא֥וּ פָנַ֖י רֵיקָֽם׃

controles.web: The firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb: and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break its neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. No one shall appear before me empty.
controles.kjv: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb: and if thou redeem him not, then shalt thou break his neck. All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
controles.livre: Porém resgatarás com cordeiro o primeiro do asno; e se não o resgatares, lhe cortarás a cabeça. Resgatarás todo primogênito de teus filhos, e não serão vistos vazios diante de mim.

versos.hebraico: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲבֹ֔ד וּבַיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת בֶּחָרִ֥ישׁ וּבַקָּצִ֖יר תִּשְׁבֹּֽת׃

controles.web: “Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in plowing time and in harvest you shall rest.
controles.kjv: Six days thou shalt work, but on the seventh day thou shalt rest: in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest.
controles.livre: Seis dias trabalharás, mas no sétimo dia cessarás: cessarás ainda na arada e na colheita.

versos.hebraico: וְחַ֤ג שָׁבֻעֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לְךָ֔ בִּכּוּרֵ֖י קְצִ֣יר חִטִּ֑ים וְחַג֙ הָֽאָסִ֔יף תְּקוּפַ֖ת הַשָּׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: “You shall observe the feast of weeks with the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of harvest at the year’s end.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
controles.livre: E te farás a festa das semanas aos princípios da colheita do trigo: e a festa da colheita à volta do ano.

versos.hebraico: שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה יֵרָאֶה֙ כָּל־זְכ֣וּרְךָ֔ אֶת־פְּנֵ֛י הָֽאָדֹ֥ן׀ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord Yahweh, the God of Israel.
controles.kjv: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
controles.livre: Três vezes no ano será visto todo homem teu diante do Soberano SENHOR, Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אוֹרִ֤ישׁ גּוֹיִם֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ וְהִרְחַבְתִּ֖י אֶת־גְּבוּלֶ֑ךָ וְלֹא־יַחְמֹ֥ד אִישׁ֙ אֶֽת־אַרְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲלֹֽתְךָ֗ לֵרָאוֹת֙ אֶת־פְּנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִ֖ים בַּשָּׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: For I will drive out nations before you and enlarge your borders; neither shall any man desire your land when you go up to appear before Yahweh, your God, three times in the year.
controles.kjv: For I will cast out the nations before thee, and enlarge thy borders: neither shall any man desire thy land, when thou shalt go up to appear before the Lord thy God thrice in the year.
controles.livre: Porque eu lançarei as nações de tua presença, e alargarei teu termo: e ninguém cobiçará tua terra, quando tu subires para ser visto diante do SENHOR teu Deus três vezes no ano.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־תִשְׁחַ֥ט עַל־חָמֵ֖ץ דַּם־זִבְחִ֑י וְלֹא־יָלִ֣ין לַבֹּ֔קֶר זֶ֖בַח חַ֥ג הַפָּֽסַח׃

controles.web: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the Passover be left to the morning.
controles.kjv: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
controles.livre: Não oferecerás com levedado o sangue de meu sacrifício; nem ficará da noite para a manhã o sacrifício da festa da páscoa.

versos.hebraico: רֵאשִׁ֗ית בִּכּוּרֵי֙ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ תָּבִ֕יא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ לֹא־תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּחֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: “You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground to the house of Yahweh your God.   “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.”
controles.kjv: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the Lord thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
controles.livre: A primícia dos primeiros frutos de tua terra meterás na casa do SENHOR teu Deus. Não cozerás o cabrito no leite de sua mãe.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה כְּתָב־לְךָ֖ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֞י עַל־פִּ֣י׀ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה כָּרַ֧תִּי אִתְּךָ֛ בְּרִ֖ית וְאֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Write you these words: for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Write thou these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with thee and with Israel.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Escreve tu estas palavras; porque conforme estas palavras fiz a aliança contigo e com Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי־שָׁ֣ם עִם־יְהוָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔ל וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתָ֑ה וַיִּכְתֹּ֣ב עַל־הַלֻּחֹ֗ת אֵ֚ת דִּבְרֵ֣י הַבְּרִ֔ית עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִֽים׃

controles.web: He was there with Yahweh forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread, nor drank water. He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
controles.kjv: And he was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
controles.livre: E ele esteve ali com o SENHOR quarenta dias e quarenta noites: não comeu pão, nem bebeu água; e escreveu em tábuas as palavras da aliança, os dez dizeres.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י בְּרֶ֤דֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ מֵהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּשְׁנֵ֨י לֻחֹ֤ת הָֽעֵדֻת֙ בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּרִדְתּ֖וֹ מִן־הָהָ֑ר וּמֹשֶׁ֣ה לֹֽא־יָדַ֗ע כִּ֥י קָרַ֛ן ע֥וֹר פָּנָ֖יו בְּדַבְּר֥וֹ אִתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When Moses came down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mountain, Moses didn’t know that the skin of his face shone by reason of his speaking with him.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, descendo Moisés do monte Sinai com as duas tábuas do testemunho em sua mão, enquanto descia do monte, não sabia ele que a pele de seu rosto resplandecia, depois que havia com ele falado.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֨רְא אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְכָל־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קָרַ֖ן ע֣וֹר פָּנָ֑יו וַיִּֽירְא֖וּ מִגֶּ֥שֶׁת אֵלָֽיו׃

controles.web: When Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come near him.
controles.kjv: And when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
controles.livre: E olhou Arão e todos os filhos de Israel a Moisés, e eis que a pele de seu rosto era resplandescente; e tiveram medo de chegar-se a ele.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֤א אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ אֵלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְכָל־הַנְּשִׂאִ֖ים בָּעֵדָ֑ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֲלֵהֶֽם׃

controles.web: Moses called to them, and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned to him; and Moses spoke to them.
controles.kjv: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
controles.livre: E chamou-os Moisés; e Arão e todos os príncipes da congregação voltaram-se a ele, e Moisés lhes falou.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֥ן נִגְּשׁ֖וּ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְצַוֵּ֕ם אֵת֩ כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אִתּ֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

controles.web: Afterward all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all of the commandments that Yahweh had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
controles.kjv: And afterward all the children of Israel came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
controles.livre: E depois se chegaram todos os filhos de Israel, aos quais mandou todas as coisas que o SENHOR lhe havia dito no monte de Sinai.

versos.hebraico: וַיְכַ֣ל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִדַּבֵּ֖ר אִתָּ֑ם וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עַל־פָּנָ֖יו מַסְוֶֽה׃

controles.web: When Moses was done speaking with them, he put a veil on his face.
controles.kjv: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
controles.livre: E quando acabou Moisés de falar com eles, pôs um véu sobre seu rosto.

versos.hebraico: וּבְבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְדַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ יָסִ֥יר אֶת־הַמַּסְוֶ֖ה עַד־צֵאת֑וֹ וְיָצָ֗א וְדִבֶּר֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצֻוֶּֽה׃

controles.web: But when Moses went in before Yahweh to speak with him, he took the veil off, until he came out; and he came out, and spoke to the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
controles.kjv: But when Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded.
controles.livre: E quando vinha Moisés diante do SENHOR para falar com ele, tirava-se o véu até que saía; e saindo, falava com os filhos de Israel o que lhe era mandado;

versos.hebraico: וְרָא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה כִּ֣י קָרַ֔ן ע֖וֹר פְּנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְהֵשִׁ֨יב מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־הַמַּסְוֶה֙ עַל־פָּנָ֔יו עַד־בֹּא֖וֹ לְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: The children of Israel saw Moses’ face, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
controles.livre: E viam os filhos de Israel o rosto de Moisés, que a pele de seu rosto era resplandescente; e voltava Moisés a pôr o véu sobre seu rosto, até que entrava a falar com ele.
